convert_coco_stuff_annotations: run a python script to convert COCO Stuff 164k annotations to mmdet format using clsID_to_trID mapping
convert_mask_to_trainID: create a function that converts segmentation mask class IDs to training IDs using the clsID_to_trID dictionary
run_parallel_conversion: run the COCO Stuff dataset conversion with multiple processes using track_parallel_progress for faster processing
parse_conversion_arguments: create an argparse parser to handle COCO path, output directory name, and number of processes for dataset conversion
validate_coco_dataset_length: test the dataset conversion by validating that train and val lists total 123287 images as expected
